DEVELOPMENTDECLARATIONAND RECIPROCALEASEMENTAGREEMENT DEVELOPMENTDECLARATIONANDRECIPROCALEASEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of November 8,2005(this"Agreement"),by and amongLiberty Theaters, Inc., a New York corporation ("Lower Owner") and US Development, LLC, a Nevada limited liability company ("Upper Owner"; Upper Owner and Lower Owner, collectively, the "Owners", and individually, an "Owner"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, Lower Owner is the owner in fee of certain land known as 44-48 Union Square (a/k/a 100 East 17th Street), in the City, County and State of New York (Tax Lot 78, Block 872, Section [] on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the "Tax Map"), as more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (the "Land"; all buildings and Improvements (as herein defined) presently located thereon (the "Existing Building"; the Existing Building and any building that may hereafter be constructed in replacement in whole or in part of the Existing Building in accordance with this Agreement are referred to herein as the "Lower Building" and together with the Land are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the "Lower BuildingParcel"); WHEREAS, Upper Owner is the owner of (a) fee simple title to the air space parcel described in Schedule B annexed hereto(the"Air SpaceParcel";the Lower Building Parcel and the Air Space Parcel are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the "Parcels", and individually as a "Parcel") and (b) the Unused Development Rights (as described in Schedule C annexed hereto); WHEREAS,Upper Ownerintends to construct or cause tobe constructedwithin the Air Space Parcel (any such construction or development, "Air Space Development") a new structure or structures (the "Upper Building") incorporating all or substantially all of the Unused Development Rights, it being the intent of Upper Owner and Lower Owner that all Unused Development Rights appurtenant to and available to Lower Owner will be made available to Upper Owner for the AirSpace Development; WHEREAS, neither the Upper Building nor the Lower Building is or will be structurally or functionally independent of the other and each will depend on the other, to some extent, for structural support,enclosure,ingress and egress,utility services and certain other facilities and components necessary for the operation and use of the Air Space Parcel or the Lower Building Parcel, as the case may be; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth a preliminary understanding of their rights and obligations and to providefor the development of the Air Space Parcel and the efficient operation of eachrespective portion,estate and interest in theAirSpace Parcel and the Lower BuildingParcel, to assure the harmonious relationship among them

and each such respective portion, estate or interest, and to protect the respective values of each such portion, estate and interest. NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained and other valuable consideration,the mutual receipt and legal sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI SUBMISSIONOFFEE Section 1.1As used in this Agreement, the term "Improvement"(or, as the context requires, "Improvement") shall mean any and all improvements, renovations, replacements,restorations,reconstructions,repairs,extensions,rebuildings,alterations, modifications, changes or additions now or hereafter located on any Parcel, and the term "Improve" shall mean to effect any Improvement or Improvements. Section 1.2The parties hereto hereby declare that: (i) Lower Owner is the owner in fee simple of the Lower Building Parcel; (i) Upper Owner is the owner in fee simple of the Air Space Parcel; (ii) all of the foregoing fee interests in and to the Parcels and the Improvements shall be subject to the easements and the other terms and provisionsofthisAgreement. ARTICLEII GRANTOFEASEMENTSTOUPPEROWNER Section 2.1Lower Owner is the grantor of the easements described in this Article I1. The grant of easements in this Article II shall bind and be enforceable against Lower Owner and its successors and assigns. The grant of an easement by Lower Owner to Upper Owner shall bind and burden the Lower Building Parcel, which shall, for the purpose of this Article II, be deemed to be the servient tenement. Section2.2Upper Owneris thegrantee of the easements described in thisArticleII.Theeasements shall benefitUpper Ownerandits successors and/or assigns. The grant of an easement to Upper Owner is appurtenant to and shall benefit the Air Space Parcel, which shall, for the purpose of this Article II, be deemed to be the dominant tenement. Section 2.3Any easement forwhich Operational Control (hereinafter defined) has been granted to Upper Owner under this Article II shall in all events be subject to the concurrent access by Lower Owner (a) as and to the extent reasonably necessary for maintenance of the Lower Building Parcel, and (b) in an Emergency Situation (hereinafter defined).
